coverage.title: Market observations coverage
coverage.intro: What market observations say about your accounts — and how many of them they say something about.
coverage.meaning: This rate measures what WE know about your accounts. It says nothing about what they do, nor about their buying practices.
coverage.headline_one: {{covered}} account out of {{total}} has usable market observation context.
coverage.headline_other: {{covered}} accounts out of {{total}} have usable market observation context.

tiles.coveredSays: enough observed career paths to say something
tiles.insufficientSays: the company is in the corpus, but with too few paths
tiles.ambiguousSays: several companies answer, none settles it
tiles.unresolvedSays: the corpus does not know this company
tiles.homonymsSays: two companies share the same name

coverage.unavailable: Market observations could not be read. No counter is shown: a zero would read as a measurement.
coverage.empty: Your portfolio has no account yet, so there is nothing to match against the corpus.

review.title: To disambiguate
review.intro: Several companies in the corpus answer for these accounts. Until one settles it, no memory is shown on them — a wrong join is worse than a missing one.

decide.question: Which of these companies is {{account}}?
decide.confirmed: Match recorded. This account leaves the queue.
decide.dismissed: Dismissed. This account leaves the queue, and nothing is asserted about it.
decide.failed: The decision could not be recorded. Nothing changed.

fit.title: Structural fit of your portfolio
fit.headline_one: {{count}} covered account whose observed stack overlaps one of your declared areas of expertise.
fit.headline_other: {{count}} covered accounts whose observed stack overlaps one of your declared areas of expertise.
fit.noGrade: No grading, and no score: saying "strong affinity" would require comparing each account with companies of similar size and sector, which we cannot do yet. A large group mechanically lists more technologies than a small business.
fit.undeclared: Fill in your areas of expertise in your profile to read this section — without a criterion, a number would mean nothing.
